$note: Phase-3 blocks: four archetypes × three hand-authored levels (design D2: dual axes per archetype, ~1.3× per stat per level, cost matched to the compounded ~1.7× power so gold-per-output stays flat), real swarm/tank/runner stat blocks, and the reserved slow-immune brute (unused until Phase 4). Rows tuned against the leak-rate harness (tests/leak.test.ts): the rapid range came down from phase-2's 3.5 so one archetype can no longer cover both maze ends, and each enemy type's punisher pressure is asserted directionally there, not by feel. Balance-ux-tweaks pass: area damage down one step (L1 now 3-shots a 50hp swarm instead of 2), slow row rescaled from 60 and wall up to 20 so mazing itself carries real cost, waveBonus pays settlement gold that decays once a wave runs past its last scheduled spawn + grace (design D4) — replacing interest as the tempo incentive. Scale-world-experiment pass: board ×2 (40×20), ranges ×1.8, hp ×2, wall down to 3 for mazing play room, carriers flipped to a 130% boost so escapes are urgent, sacks settle at 900/1000 so intercepted theft still leaks a little, bonus windows stretched for the ×2 paths. Playtest-calibrated down from the initial ×3/×5/wall-5/sack-700 sweep: hp ×5 with unchanged bounties death-spiraled the economy by wave 4 (killing a loaded swarm netted less than it stole), so the dials settled here and level_01's startingTreasury rose to 500.
